author: Kuhn & Rueß GmbH
description:
Monitors Checkmk service groups via Livestatus. Every service group matching one of the configured patterns becomes its own service. The service alarms when a single member, a configurable amount of members or all members of the group are in a problem state and/or stale. Problem state and staleness are configured independently.

The special agent runs on the Checkmk server and needs exactly two Livestatus queries per site, independent of the number of monitored service groups. Only service groups and services which are actually affected are transferred.

Assign the special agent rule to a host representing the Checkmk site. For distributed setups several Livestatus sockets can be configured, their results are merged per service group.
name: servicegroup_states
title: Checkmk Service Group States
